consequence.statement: v1 Bucket objects (including status writes) that have status.artifact but no status.artifact.digest are rejected by the API server's schema validation.
consequence.remediation: Make sure every Bucket status artifact includes a digest. The controller normally writes this field. Check for any tooling that writes or restores Bucket status without it.

assertion.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 Bucket schema, `status.artifact.digest` is now a required field, so Bucket objects whose status artifact leaves out the digest are rejected.

checks.detail: crd-field now-required is not render-verifiable (runtime-only or no rendered shape)
